title: Study design and scientific questions
caption: The study separates benchmark validity, grouped classification, GC composition sensitivity, quantitative reporter activity and assay transfer. All numbers derive from locked manifests or declared fit counts; no new model family or long-context experiment was added.

title: Historical overlap, grouping and decontamination limit
caption: A: supplied test exact matches to supplied training, all in strong class. Reverse-complement-only matches were absent. B: actual retained candidate graph-component sizes, using the original LCS160 and exact/RC grouping protocol; logarithmic count scale near zero. C: duplicate-cleaned historical Stage2 test has no positives. The optional three-model historical experiment stopped under the authentication rule; these counts do not quantify a causal leakage effect.

title: Grouped classification and exact-GC evaluation
caption: Points show equal averages of five within-fold AUROCs calculated from fixed predictions. Fine-tuned DNABERT rows use current three-seed ensemble scores; other rows are archived single runs. Error bars are descriptive fold SD, not independent-replicate confidence intervals or seed SD. Diamonds use all opposite-label pairs with identical GC count inside each fold; matching changes eligible pairs and controls only GC count. Its lower performance cannot be interpreted as causal removal of all composition effects.

title: Repeated training and conditional ensemble contrasts
caption: Left and middle: per-seed mean-fold AUROC for three current consistent fits per fold, with horizontal mean marks. Right: paired differences of pooled three-seed ensembles, with Phase41 similarity-group bootstrap intervals; both contain zero. Seed spread, fold variation and conditional cohort uncertainty are different quantities. Fifteen seed×fold entries are not independent replicates; no equivalence conclusion follows.

title: Quantitative activity prediction and duration control
caption: Top: three-seed ensemble diamonds and individual-seed circles for selected neural recipes, plus one explicitly archived spaced-mer baseline. Bottom: Phase41 conditional locus-group bootstrap intervals. The fixed2e-5 duration comparison uses each new fit’s own exact first-two-epoch prefix. The model comparison follows validation-only grid selection. Equal numbers of candidate recipes do not establish equal compute or exhaustive tuning; grid-boundary and budget-cap caveats remain.

title: Assay transfer, calibration and population failure modes
caption: A–B use current three-seed selected neural models on frozen DHS-natural sequences. All external ensemble R2 values are negative, despite positive rank correlations. C–D are explicitly different, older fitted-model diagnostics from Phases16–24; they are not predictions of the new selected models. C uses fixed measured-activity bands and is a target-dependent diagnostic. D compares errors in different retained/removed populations, not causal retraining effects; paired exploratory intervals and subgroup counts are in the supplement.

title: Fixed OOF classification curves
caption: Current three-seed fine-tuned ensembles and seven archived single-run baselines. Curves pool fixed OOF predictions; not an untouched independent test. No threshold was chosen from these curves.

title: Probability reliability on fixed OOF cohorts
caption: Ten fixed probability bins, with bins below20 records suppressed from the plot; Brier and all confusion counts remain in TableS5. Current ensembles versus archived baselines are explicit. This is a descriptive OOF diagnostic, not recalibration.

title: All 54 validation trajectories
caption: Each line is one declared candidate/seed fit. Colors denote the three ordered learning-rate grid positions. Curves retain the two practical near-constant high-LR DNABERT-2 runs. Stopping policies differ by model; no claim of exhaustive convergence.

title: Candidate grids and validation-only choices
caption: Means and sample SD across exactly three seeds. Dashed vertical lines mark locked choices. Large DNABERT-2 high-LR spread includes practical collapses; no fit was dropped. Upper/lower grid-boundary selections remain visible.

title: Recorded fitting time under unequal recipes
caption: Sum across nine completed candidate/seed fits per model/cell. Runtime is hardware/implementation dependent and excludes pretrained-model production cost. Same candidate count does not imply equal GPU time, steps or FLOPs.

title: Older fitted-model interval coverage
caption: Marginal nominal90% intervals under the original disjoint calibration/audit scheme. These are older fitted models and populations, not a coverage guarantee for Phase35 models. Subgroup coverage and n remain in TableS13.

title: Practical collapse alongside the frozen flag
caption: The frozen undefined-Pearson rule flags zero fits. A post hoc descriptive SD<1e-4 screen identifies two practical near-constant fits, one per cell at DNABERT-2 LR5e-5/seed20260932. All54 fits and the locked three-seed selection remain unchanged. No training root cause is inferred.
